newsitem.title: USA: Amtech wins $38.6 mln Fla toll contract.
newsitem.headline: Amtech wins $38.6 mln Fla toll contract.

text.p: Amtech Corp said on Tuesday that its Transportation Systems Group received a $38.6 million contract from the Florida Department of Transportation for a state-wide, non-stop electronic toll collection system.

The company said the contract is expected to be funded incrementally year-to-year by the Florida Department of Transportation, and initial funding of $10.4 million has already been approved, with funding for the balance expected in future fiscal-year installments.
Implementation of Florida's new SunPass system will begin in late 1997 and is scheduled to be completed in the year 2000, it said.

Amtech will install, integrate, and maintain an advanced version of its Intellitag product line at all Florida Department of Transportation toll locations throughout Florida. Amtech will supply Florida Department of Transportation with 327,000 SunPass vehicle tags.
The contract calls for 92 lanes to be dedicated exclusively to electronic toll collection and 16 of the lanes to be designated as express lanes.
The new system will also be integrated with existing coin and manual equipment on the remaining 347 lanes.
